## 1. Brand Overview & Mission
Sleek Koncepts is an architectural interior design studio delivering premium turnkey residential interiors. The brand emphasizes the intersection of functional ergonomic design, architectural aesthetics, and high-precision factory-manufactured modular carpentry.

Unlike traditional unorganized carpentry, Sleek Koncepts operates a precision factory production line utilizing Computer Numerical Control (CNC) edge-banding and calibrated boring machines. This eliminates dust, delays, and carpentry inconsistencies on-site.

---

## 2. Core Service Offerings

### A. Modular Kitchen Design
- **Layouts Supported**: Island Kitchens, L-Shaped Kitchens, Parallel / Galley Kitchens, U-Shaped Kitchens, Straight-line Kitchens, and Open Kitchens with Breakfast Counters.
- **Core Materials**: IS:710 Marine-Grade Calibrated Boiling Water Proof (BWP) Plywood. High resistance to boiling water, moisture, fungus, borer, and termite attacks.
- **Shutters & Finishes**: High-gloss Anti-Scratch Acrylic, Super-Matte PU Polish, Anti-Fingerprint Matte Laminates, Fluted Glass Profiles, and Natural Wood Veneers.
- **Hardware & Mechanisms**: Soft-close Tandem boxes, Corner Carousel units (Lemans corner, Magic corner), Bi-fold lift-ups (Blum Aventos style), Pantry pull-outs, Cutlery organizers, and integrated dustbins. Certified hardware by Blum, Hettich, and Hafele.
- **Countertops**: Caesarstone Quartz, Kalinga Stone, Corian Solid Surface, and High-Grade Granite with under-mount stainless steel or quartz composite sinks.

### B. Living Room Interiors
- **TV & Media Feature Walls**: Large format glazed vitrified porcelain tiles, Italian marble slabs, CNC fluted wood panels, acoustic felt panels, brass/rose-gold metallic inlays.
- **Concealed Cable Engineering**: 100% hidden conduit wiring for smart TVs, soundbars, subwoofers, gaming consoles, and streaming devices.
- **False Ceiling & Lighting**: Indirect cove lighting (warm white 3000K), magnetic track lights, recessed anti-glare COB spotlights, and dimmable smart ambience controllers.
- **Foyer & Partition Screens**: Fluted glass screens, brass jaali designs, and integrated entryway shoe cabinetry with seating benches.

### C. Bedroom Interiors
- **Master Bedroom Suites**: Custom upholstered headboards with acoustic fabric or vegan leather, wall-to-wall feature paneling, floating bedside units with integrated USB/wireless charging points.
- **Bed Options**: Hydraulic lift-up storage beds, floating platform beds with perimeter under-glow LED illumination, and drawer-storage beds.
- **Kids & Teen Bedrooms**: Ergonomic study desks with cork boards, overhead bookshelves, bunk beds, and colorful durable laminates.
- **Guest Bedrooms**: Space-saving functional layouts balancing luxury aesthetics with practical wardrobe storage.

### D. Wardrobe & Closet Design
- **Types**: Floor-to-Ceiling Sliding Door Wardrobes, 3-Door / 4-Door Hinged Wardrobes, Walk-in Wardrobes with Dressing Islands, and Tinted Glass Aluminum Profile Wardrobes.
- **Internal Organizers**: Soft-close velvet jewelry trays, pull-out trouser racks, tie and belt organizers, hydraulic pull-down wardrobe lifts for high compartments, and integrated infrared sensor LED hanger rods.
- **Loft Storage**: Full-height floor-to-ceiling execution ensuring zero dead space and no dust accumulation on top.

### E. Additional Turnkey Services
- **Pooja Rooms**: Traditional and contemporary mandirs with CNC laser-cut jaali screens, backlit onyx stone, brass bells, and incense ventilation.
- **False Ceilings**: Saint-Gobain Gyproc moisture-resistant plasterboards, geometric cove drops, and perimeter acoustic designs.
- **Civil & Electrical Works**: Complete structural modifications, wall relocations, plumbing rerouting, and turnkey electrical line distribution.

---

## 3. Our 9-Step Methodology
1. **Initial Discovery Consultation**: Understand family lifestyle, functional requirements, aesthetic tastes, and budget expectations.
2. **Precision Laser Site Measurement**: High-accuracy digital laser measurement capturing beam drops, wall plumbness, and plumbing/electrical points.
3. **2D Space Planning & Zoning**: Ergonomic floor layout options optimizing circulation paths and storage ratios.
4. **Photorealistic 3D Visualization**: High-resolution 3D renders displaying exact material swatches, colors, lighting temperatures, and textures.
5. **Bill of Quantities (BOQ) & Contract**: Itemized, transparent pricing with no hidden costs, clear milestones, and committed handover dates.
6. **Factory CNC Precision Manufacturing**: Automated sizing, multi-axis drilling, and 1.2mm PUR edge-banding in a controlled factory environment.
7. **Pre-Dispatch Quality Audit**: Rigorous factory testing of hinge alignments, drawer sliding smoothness, and dimensional tolerances.
8. **On-Site Dust-Free Assembly**: Clean installation by trained company technicians within 3 to 5 days on site.
9. **Final Deep Clean & Handover**: Formal room-by-room inspection, warranty documentation handover, and post-installation care guide.

---

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) & Direct Answers

**Q1: How much does an interior design project cost with Sleek Koncepts?**
A: Project costs depend on the carpet area, finish choices (e.g., acrylic vs. laminate vs. PU polish), and scope (modular kitchen only vs. complete turnkey 2BHK/3BHK villa). Sleek Koncepts provides a completely transparent, itemized Bill of Quantities (BOQ) with fixed square footage pricing following the 2D layout stage. There are zero surprise costs midway through execution.

**Q2: What is the typical completion and delivery timeline?**
A: Full-home 2BHK or 3BHK turnkey interior projects are typically delivered within 45 to 60 working days after 3D design approval. Standalone modular kitchens or custom wardrobe installations are completed in 25 to 30 days.

**Q3: Which locations and cities does Sleek Koncepts serve?**
A: Sleek Koncepts is headquartered in Karimnagar, Telangana. The studio executes turnkey interior projects across Karimnagar, Hyderabad, Warangal, Jagtial, Peddapalli, Sircilla, Ramagundam, and neighboring areas throughout Telangana, India.

**Q4: What core materials are used for modular kitchens?**
A: Sleek Koncepts strictly uses IS:710 certified BWP (Boiling Water Proof) calibrated marine-grade plywood for kitchen base cabinets and wet zones. For hardware, Sleek Koncepts partners with top German brands including Blum, Hettich, and Hafele for lifetime smooth soft-close operation.

**Q5: What is the difference between Acrylic and PU Polish finishes?**
A: Acrylic provides a mirror-like high gloss with excellent scratch and UV resistance, ideal for modern vibrant kitchens. PU (polyurethane) polish offers an ultra-luxurious silky matte finish with seamless edges and customizable RAL shades, perfect for minimalist and contemporary spaces.

**Q6: Do you provide photorealistic 3D designs before execution begins?**
A: Yes. Sleek Koncepts provides photorealistic 3D perspectives of every room showing the exact materials, colors, lighting, and finishes so clients can visualize their space before any factory fabrication starts.

**Q7: Can I book a free design consultation?**
A: Yes, initial 1-on-1 design consultations are completely free. Clients can book directly at https://sleekkoncepts.com/contact.html or by calling +91 8143965633.
